mlp1_toolchain_image_note: Digest-pinned published toolchain. The locally built ':local' tag is not a build input: it is produced from an unpinned main checkout and its content can drift between machines. Override TOOLCHAIN_IMAGE only for deliberate toolchain development, never for the distributable lane.

flags.note: Replaces the sibling ../mlp1-toolchain/flags mount: an arbitrary local checkout is not reproducible. The archive hash is the size/SHA receipt for one fetch of the pinned commit; GitHub tarballs are re-encoded occasionally (observed 2026-09-20: 12095 bytes via the API, 12081 via the web URL, identical extracted contents), so the file rows below are the authoritative check and a drifted receipt alone never blocks the build.
